title: Rav Yehudah of Daaskarta or Daskarta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman finds him always raising objections to Rava in Yevamot 87, Nazir 35, Sotah 6 and 25, and Niddah 35 and 39; apparently he was one of Rava’s leading students. In Nazir 52a he offers a proof concerning Rava’s question. In Shabbat 93a he disputes Rav Zevid’s report in Rava’s name. In Gittin 28b Rav Ada bar Matna objects to Rava; Rav Yehudah of Daskarta answers, “A wineskin is different.” Rav Mesharshiya objects: “Does your guarantor need a guarantor?” Rava then gives a different answer, etc.
Hyman concludes that he was senior to Rav Papa: in Niddah 39 Rav Papa says, “I recited the teaching before Rav Yehudah of Daskarta.”

notes.text: The unmarked folios remain without added a/b designations. His rank as a leading student and seniority to Rav Papa are Hyman’s inferences.

The consulted Gittin 28b explicitly has Rav Ada bar Matna objecting to Rava, Rav Yehudah of Daskarta answering about a wineskin, Rav Mesharshiya objecting and Rava then answering. Hyman’s “always” assertion, leading-student inference and seniority to Rav Papa remain his judgments. Unmarked supplied folios receive no invented side.
